title: Patch: drop practice.css's dead result-dialog selectors left after the move onto Dialog

**Issue #3459 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3459: Patch: drop practice.css's dead result-dialog selectors left after the move onto Dialog
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

#3220 moved the practice result onto `game/Dialog.tsx` and kept the old `.practice-result*` selectors in `apps/web/src/practice/practice.css` as "twins" beside the new `.dialog` ones, so that TutorialResult, which still rendered the old markup, kept its look. Its plan said the next part would remove the twins once TutorialResult moved too. #3221 moved TutorialResult (`<Dialog className="practice-result tutorial-result">`) but left the twins. Some of the selectors in practice.css now match nothing, and others repeat a partner in the same selector list.

Line numbers are on `main` at `3163b425c1`:

- **Dead:** nothing in `apps/web/src` or `e2e` renders `practice-result__title`, `practice-result__reason` or `practice-result__actions`. `git grep -nE 'practice-result__(title|reason|actions)' -- apps e2e` finds only practice.css, at lines 1035, 1055, 1069, 1077, 1081, 1408, 1413, 1418, 1425 and 1431.
- **Redundant:** the bare `.practice-result` at lines 891, 1134 and 1388 sits in the same selector list as `.dialog.practice-result`. Both result screens render `class="dialog practice-result …"`, so the two selectors match the same element.

Change:

- Where a selector list pairs an old selector with its `.dialog` partner, keep the partner and drop the old one.
- Delete the two rules whose only selector is dead: `.practice-result__actions > *` (1077) and `.practice .practice-result__actions .practice-play` (1081).
- At 1418, drop only the dead half of the list.
- Keep `.practice-result` where it is an ancestor, as in `.practice-result .practice-crest--lg` and `.practice-result .dialog__…`.
- Reword the comment at lines 889-890, which still calls the `.dialog` selectors twins.

Nothing should change on screen. Every removed selector either matched no element or sat in the same rule as a partner that matches the same element.

Deleting whole rules lowers practice.css's counts in the token tests. For example, `spacing.test.ts` and `typescale.test.ts` count the `padding` and the `font-size` at line 1081. Lower each count to what the test reports, and never raise one.

### Acceptance

- `git grep -nE 'practice-result__(title|reason|actions)' -- apps e2e` finds nothing.
- No selector list in `practice.css` holds both `.practice-result` and `.dialog.practice-result`.
- A unit test fails if `practice.css` names any of the three classes again. Extend the check at `apps/web/src/game/Dialog.test.tsx:231`, which already rejects `practice-leave` and `practice-result-scrim`.
- practice.css's counts in the token tests (`palette`, `typescale`, `surfaces`, `motion`, `spacing`, `breakpoints`) go down or stay the same, and none rises.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, the web typecheck and eslint pass, and so do e2e specs `46` and `47`.

### Blocked by, part of

None. This follows up #3220 and #3221, from the closed tracker #3231.

## Goal

Remove the dead `.practice-result__title`, `.practice-result__reason` and `.practice-result__actions` selectors left in `apps/web/src/practice/practice.css` after #3220/#3221 moved the practice and tutorial results onto `game/Dialog.tsx`, drop the bare `.practice-result` wherever it shares a selector list with its `.dialog.practice-result` partner, and reword the stale "twins" comment. Nothing on screen changes: every removed selector either matched no element or sat in the same rule as a partner matching the same element.

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/practice/practice.css` | change | 14 selector edits/deletions plus the comment reword in the result-dialog section and its two `@media` blocks |
| `apps/web/src/game/Dialog.test.tsx` | change | Line 231 regex also rejects the three dead classes |
| `apps/web/src/spacing.test.ts` | change | `practice/practice.css` count 131 down to the test-reported value |
| `apps/web/src/typescale.test.ts` | change | `practice/practice.css` count 33 down to the test-reported value |
| `apps/web/src/palette.test.ts` | change only if its test reports a drop, else untouched | `practice/practice.css` count 33, lower only |
| `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts` | change only if its test reports a drop, else untouched | `practice/practice.css` count 62, lower only |
| `apps/web/src/motion.test.ts` | change only if its test reports a drop, else untouched | `practice/practice.css` count 42, lower only |
| `apps/web/src/breakpoints.test.ts` | change only if its test reports a drop, else untouched | `practice/practice.css` KEEP entry, shorten only |

Do not touch crates, `spec/`, `e2e/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `bot/`. No new ruling note and no `spec/pending` paragraph: this changes no behavior, so it makes no Hearthstone-semantics decision. R3220000 (the one Dialog) and R3221000 (the menus' dialogs on it) are context only.

## Steps

Work in order; each step names its file and exact text.

1. In `apps/web/src/practice/practice.css`, reword the comment at lines 889-890. Old: ``whose scrim is dialog.css's: the `.dialog` twins below give its panel this look.`` New: ``whose scrim is dialog.css's: the `.dialog` selectors below give its panel this look.``
2. Line 891: delete the `.practice-result,` line; keep `.dialog.practice-result {`. Both result screens render `class="dialog practice-result …"` (`PracticeResult.tsx`, `TutorialResult.tsx`), so the partner matches the same element.
3. Line 1035: delete `.app-shell .practice-result__title,`; keep `.app-shell .practice-result .dialog__title {`. Nothing renders `practice-result__title` (verified: `git grep` finds it only in practice.css).
4. Line 1055: delete `.app-shell .practice-result__reason,`; keep `.app-shell .practice-result .dialog__body {`.
5. Line 1069: delete `.practice-result__actions,`; keep `.practice-result .dialog__actions {`.
6. Delete the whole rule `.practice-result__actions > * { flex: 1 1 0; }` (lines 1077-1079) and leave a single blank line between the neighboring rules.
7. Delete the whole rule `.practice .practice-result__actions .practice-play { min-width: 0; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 16px; }` (lines 1081-1085) and leave a single blank line.
8. Lines 1134-1136 (reduced-motion block): delete the `  .practice-result,` line; keep `  .dialog.practice-result,` and `  .practice-result__rays {`.
9. Line 1388 (`@media (max-height: 500px)` block): delete the `  .practice-result,` line; keep `  .dialog.practice-result {`.
10. Line 1408: delete `  .app-shell .practice-result__title,`; keep the `.dialog__title` line.
11. Line 1413: delete `  .practice-result__actions,`; keep the `.dialog__actions` line.
12. Line 1418: delete only the dead half `  .practice .practice-result__actions .practice-play,`; keep `  .practice .practice-result__secondary {`.
13. Line 1425 (`@media (max-width: 420px)` block): delete `  .practice-result__actions,` from the three-selector list; keep `.practice-result .dialog__actions,` and `.practice-result__replay {`.
14. Line 1431: delete `  .app-shell .practice-result__title,`; keep the `.dialog__title` line.
15. Do not touch selectors where `.practice-result` is an ancestor: `.practice-result .practice-crest--lg` (1403), `.practice-result .dialog__title`, `.practice-result .dialog__body`, `.practice-result .dialog__actions`, `.app-shell .practice-result__meta` (1061, live class), and all `__emblem`/`__rays`/`__particles`/`__replay`/`__secondary`/`__view`/`__meta` rules both screens still render.
16. In `apps/web/src/game/Dialog.test.tsx` line 231, extend the existing assertion (same `it`, no new test name) to: `expect(readSheet("src/practice/practice.css")).not.toMatch(/practice-leave|practice-result-scrim|practice-result__(title|reason|actions)/);`. The group matches only the three dead names, not the live `__emblem`, `__rays`, `__particles`, `__replay`, `__secondary`, `__view`, `__meta`, nor `dialog__actions`.
17. Run the token tests and lower counts to exactly what each failure reports, never raising one. Expected: `spacing.test.ts` 131 to 129 (`padding: 12px 16px` held two counted lengths) and `typescale.test.ts` 33 to 32 (one `font-size: 16px` gone); palette, surfaces, motion and breakpoints most likely unchanged since the deleted rules hold no color, radius/shadow/gradient, animation, or media query.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/game/Dialog.test.tsx`, `it("R3220000 one scrim at --z-dialog, and the five keep no Escape or scrim of their own")`: the extended line-231 assertion fails if practice.css names any of the three classes again. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Dialog.test.tsx`.
- Token tests, one file per run: `pnpm --dir apps/web test spacing.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test typescale.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test palette.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test surfaces.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test motion.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test breakpoints.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`; eslint on the touched web files; e2e specs `46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts` and `47-tap-areas.cy.ts` per `e2e/README.md`.
- Greps: `git grep -nE 'practice-result__(title|reason|actions)' -- apps e2e` finds nothing; eyeball that no selector list in practice.css holds both `.practice-result` and `.dialog.practice-result`.

## Done when

- The grep finds nothing and no selector list pairs `.practice-result` with `.dialog.practice-result`, while the ancestor selectors (`.practice-result .practice-crest--lg`, `.practice-result .dialog__…`) are intact.
- `Dialog.test.tsx`, all six token tests, typecheck, eslint and e2e specs 46 and 47 pass.
- Every token count for practice.css went down or stayed the same, and none rose.

## Risks

- Dropping a `.practice-result` that is an ancestor rather than a twin would change the look. Avoid it by only deleting a bare `.practice-result` that shares its own selector list with `.dialog.practice-result`, and by deleting only the named dead half at line 1418.
- An over-broad test regex could match live classes and fail forever; the `(title|reason|actions)` group matches only the three dead names.
- Token counts must only move down: copy the number the failing test reports, never invent one. If a token test reports a higher number than the file holds, stop and report instead of raising it.

## Open questions

None.
```
